# 模块化设计

> **版本**：v1.0  
> **最后更新**：2026-04-20

## 📚 概念介绍

Effect 提供了强大的模块化设计能力，支持清晰的模块边界、灵活的依赖管理、优雅的接口设计和可组合的模块组合，帮助开发者构建可维护、可扩展的应用。

## 🎯 模块边界

### 基本模块边界

```js
import { Effect } from 'effect'

// 基本模块边界
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  // 定义模块
  const UserModule = {
    state: new Map(),
    
    // 公共接口
    services: {
      UserService: {
        create: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
          console.log('[UserModule] Creating user')
          const user = { id: Date.now(), ...data }
          UserModule.state.set(user.id, user)
          return user
        }),
        
        get: (id) => Effect.gen(function* () {
          const user = UserModule.state.get(id)
          return user ? Effect.succeed(user) : Effect.fail(new Error('User not found'))
        })
      }
    },
    
    // 私有实现
    private: {
      validate: (data) => {
        return data.name && data.email
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 使用模块
  const user = yield* UserModule.services.UserService.create({
    name: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com'
  })
  
  console.log('Created user:', user)
  
  const retrieved = yield* UserModule.services.UserService.get(user.id)
  console.log('Retrieved user:', retrieved)
  
  return user
})

Effect.runSync(program)
```

### 模块边界实现

```js
import { Effect } from 'effect'

// 模块边界实现
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  // 模块定义
  const createModule = (name, dependencies = {}) => {
    const module = {
      name,
      dependencies,
      state: new Map(),
      services: {},
      
      registerService: (serviceName, service) => {
        module.services[serviceName] = service
      },
      
      getService: (serviceName) => {
        return module.services[serviceName]
      }
    }
    
    return module
  }
  
  // 创建用户模块
  const userModule = createModule('UserModule')
  
  userModule.registerService('UserService', {
    create: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log(`[${userModule.name}] Creating user`)
      
      // 使用依赖
      if (userModule.dependencies.validator) {
        const isValid = yield* userModule.dependencies.validator.validate(data)
        if (!isValid) {
          return Effect.fail(new Error('Invalid user data'))
        }
      }
      
      const user = { id: Date.now(), ...data }
      userModule.state.set(user.id, user)
      return user
    }),
    
    get: (id) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const user = userModule.state.get(id)
      return user ? Effect.succeed(user) : Effect.fail(new Error('User not found'))
    })
  })
  
  // 创建验证模块
  const validatorModule = createModule('ValidatorModule')
  
  validatorModule.registerService('ValidatorService', {
    validate: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log(`[${validatorModule.name}] Validating data`)
      return Effect.succeed(!!data.name && !!data.email)
    })
  })
  
  // 设置依赖
  userModule.dependencies = {
    validator: validatorModule.services.ValidatorService
  }
  
  // 使用模块
  const user = yield* userModule.services.UserService.create({
    name: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com'
  })
  
  console.log('Created user:', user)
  
  return user
})

Effect.runSync(program)
```

## 💡 依赖管理

### 基本依赖管理

```js
import { Effect } from 'effect'

// 基本依赖管理
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  // 依赖容器
  const Container = {
    services: new Map(),
    
    register: (name, service) => {
      Container.services.set(name, service)
    },
    
    get: (name) => {
      return Container.services.get(name)
    },
    
    resolve: (name) => {
      const service = Container.get(name)
      if (!service) {
        throw new Error(`Service ${name} not found`)
      }
      return service
    }
  }
  
  // 注册服务
  Container.register('Logger', {
    log: (message) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log(`[Logger] ${message}`)
      return Effect.succeed(true)
    })
  })
  
  Container.register('Database', {
    save: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const logger = Container.resolve('Logger')
      yield* logger.log(`Saving data: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`)
      yield* Effect.sleep(100)
      return Effect.succeed({ id: Date.now(), ...data })
    })
  })
  
  Container.register('UserService', {
    create: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const logger = Container.resolve('Logger')
      const database = Container.resolve('Database')
      
      yield* logger.log('Creating user')
      const user = yield* database.save(data)
      
      return user
    })
  })
  
  // 使用依赖注入
  const userService = Container.resolve('UserService')
  const user = yield* userService.create({
    name: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com'
  })
  
  console.log('Created user:', user)
  
  return user
})

Effect.runSync(program)
```

### 依赖注入

```js
import { Effect } from 'effect'

// 依赖注入
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  // 服务定义
  const Logger = {
    create: (prefix) => ({
      log: (message) => Effect.gen(function* () {
        console.log(`[${prefix}] ${message}`)
        return Effect.succeed(true)
      })
    })
  }
  
  const Database = {
    create: (logger) => ({
      save: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
        yield* logger.log(`Saving: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`)
        yield* Effect.sleep(100)
        return Effect.succeed({ id: Date.now(), ...data })
      })
    })
  }
  
  const UserService = {
    create: (logger, database) => ({
      create: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
        yield* logger.log('Creating user')
        const user = yield* database.save(data)
        return user
      })
    })
  }
  
  // 依赖注入容器
  const DIContainer = {
    // 手动注入
    createUserService: () => {
      const logger = Logger.create('UserService')
      const database = Database.create(logger)
      return UserService.create(logger, database)
    }
  }
  
  // 使用依赖注入
  const userService = DIContainer.createUserService()
  const user = yield* userService.create({
    name: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com'
  })
  
  console.log('Created user:', user)
  
  return user
})

Effect.runSync(program)
```

### 依赖解析

```js
import { Effect } from 'effect'

// 依赖解析
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  // 依赖图
  const DependencyGraph = {
    nodes: new Map(),
    
    addNode: (name, factory, dependencies = []) => {
      DependencyGraph.nodes.set(name, { factory, dependencies, instance: null })
    },
    
    resolve: (name, visited = new Set()) => {
      if (visited.has(name)) {
        throw new Error(`Circular dependency detected: ${name}`)
      }
      
      const node = DependencyGraph.nodes.get(name)
      if (!node) {
        throw new Error(`Service ${name} not found`)
      }
      
      if (node.instance) {
        return node.instance
      }
      
      visited.add(name)
      
      // 解析依赖
      const resolvedDependencies = node.dependencies.map(dep => 
        DependencyGraph.resolve(dep, new Set(visited))
      )
      
      // 创建实例
      node.instance = node.factory(...resolvedDependencies)
      
      return node.instance
    }
  }
  
  // 添加服务
  DependencyGraph.addNode('Logger', () => ({
    log: (message) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log(`[Logger] ${message}`)
      return Effect.succeed(true)
    })
  }))
  
  DependencyGraph.addNode('Database', (logger) => ({
    save: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      yield* logger.log(`Saving: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`)
      yield* Effect.sleep(100)
      return Effect.succeed({ id: Date.now(), ...data })
    })
  }), ['Logger'])
  
  DependencyGraph.addNode('UserService', (logger, database) => ({
    create: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      yield* logger.log('Creating user')
      const user = yield* database.save(data)
      return user
    })
  }), ['Logger', 'Database'])
  
  // 解析并使用服务
  const userService = DependencyGraph.resolve('UserService')
  const user = yield* userService.create({
    name: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com'
  })
  
  console.log('Created user:', user)
  
  return user
})

Effect.runSync(program)
```

## 🚀 接口设计

### 基本接口设计

```js
import { Effect } from 'effect'

// 基本接口设计
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  // 定义接口
  const Interfaces = {
    UserRepository: {
      save: (user) => Effect.Effect,
      findById: (id) => Effect.Effect,
      findByEmail: (email) => Effect.Effect,
      delete: (id) => Effect.Effect
    },
    
    EmailService: {
      send: (to, subject, body) => Effect.Effect,
      sendTemplate: (to, template, data) => Effect.Effect
    },
    
    UserService: {
      register: (data) => Effect.Effect,
      login: (email, password) => Effect.Effect,
      updateProfile: (id, data) => Effect.Effect
    }
  }
  
  // 实现接口
  const InMemoryUserRepository = {
    users: new Map(),
    
    save: (user) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log('[InMemoryUserRepository] Saving user')
      InMemoryUserRepository.users.set(user.id, user)
      return Effect.succeed(user)
    }),
    
    findById: (id) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const user = InMemoryUserRepository.users.get(id)
      return user ? Effect.succeed(user) : Effect.fail(new Error('User not found'))
    }),
    
    findByEmail: (email) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const user = Array.from(InMemoryUserRepository.users.values())
        .find(u => u.email === email)
      return user ? Effect.succeed(user) : Effect.fail(new Error('User not found'))
    }),
    
    delete: (id) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const deleted = InMemoryUserRepository.users.delete(id)
      return deleted ? Effect.succeed(true) : Effect.fail(new Error('User not found'))
    })
  }
  
  const ConsoleEmailService = {
    send: (to, subject, body) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log(`[ConsoleEmailService] To: ${to}, Subject: ${subject}`)
      console.log(`Body: ${body}`)
      yield* Effect.sleep(50)
      return Effect.succeed(true)
    }),
    
    sendTemplate: (to, template, data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log(`[ConsoleEmailService] To: ${to}, Template: ${template}`)
      console.log(`Data: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`)
      yield* Effect.sleep(50)
      return Effect.succeed(true)
    })
  }
  
  const UserServiceImpl = {
    userRepository: null,
    emailService: null,
    
    create: (userRepository, emailService) => {
      UserServiceImpl.userRepository = userRepository
      UserServiceImpl.emailService = emailService
      
      return {
        register: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
          console.log('[UserServiceImpl] Registering user')
          
          // 检查用户是否已存在
          const existing = yield* UserServiceImpl.userRepository.findByEmail(data.email).pipe(
            Effect.catchAll(() => Effect.succeed(null))
          )
          
          if (existing) {
            return Effect.fail(new Error('User already exists'))
          }
          
          // 创建用户
          const user = {
            id: Date.now(),
            name: data.name,
            email: data.email,
            createdAt: new Date()
          }
          
          yield* UserServiceImpl.userRepository.save(user)
          yield* UserServiceImpl.emailService.send(
            user.email,
            'Welcome',
            'Welcome to our platform!'
          )
          
          return user
        }),
        
        login: (email, password) => Effect.gen(function* () {
          console.log('[UserServiceImpl] Logging in user')
          const user = yield* UserServiceImpl.userRepository.findByEmail(email)
          return user
        }),
        
        updateProfile: (id, data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
          console.log('[UserServiceImpl] Updating user profile')
          const user = yield* UserServiceImpl.userRepository.findById(id)
          const updated = { ...user, ...data }
          yield* UserServiceImpl.userRepository.save(updated)
          return updated
        })
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 使用接口
  const userService = UserServiceImpl.create(
    InMemoryUserRepository,
    ConsoleEmailService
  )
  
  const user = yield* userService.register({
    name: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com'
  })
  
  console.log('Registered user:', user)
  
  return user
})

Effect.runSync(program)
```

### 接口组合

```js
import { Effect } from 'effect'

// 接口组合
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  // 定义基础接口
  const BaseInterfaces = {
    Repository: {
      create: (data) => Effect.Effect,
      read: (id) => Effect.Effect,
      update: (id, data) => Effect.Effect,
      delete: (id) => Effect.Effect
    },
    
    Service: {
      execute: (command) => Effect.Effect
    }
  }
  
  // 组合接口
  const ComposedInterfaces = {
    UserService: {
      ...BaseInterfaces.Repository,
      ...BaseInterfaces.Service,
      
      register: (data) => Effect.Effect,
      login: (email, password) => Effect.Effect
    },
    
    OrderService: {
      ...BaseInterfaces.Repository,
      ...BaseInterfaces.Service,
      
      createOrder: (data) => Effect.Effect,
      cancelOrder: (id) => Effect.Effect
    }
  }
  
  // 实现组合接口
  const UserServiceImpl = {
    data: new Map(),
    
    create: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log('[UserServiceImpl] Creating user')
      const user = { id: Date.now(), ...data }
      UserServiceImpl.data.set(user.id, user)
      return user
    }),
    
    read: (id) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const user = UserServiceImpl.data.get(id)
      return user ? Effect.succeed(user) : Effect.fail(new Error('User not found'))
    }),
    
    update: (id, data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const user = UserServiceImpl.data.get(id)
      if (!user) {
        return Effect.fail(new Error('User not found'))
      }
      const updated = { ...user, ...data }
      UserServiceImpl.data.set(id, updated)
      return updated
    }),
    
    delete: (id) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const deleted = UserServiceImpl.data.delete(id)
      return deleted ? Effect.succeed(true) : Effect.fail(new Error('User not found'))
    }),
    
    execute: (command) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log('[UserServiceImpl] Executing command:', command.type)
      return Effect.succeed({ success: true })
    }),
    
    register: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log('[UserServiceImpl] Registering user')
      return yield* UserServiceImpl.create(data)
    }),
    
    login: (email, password) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log('[UserServiceImpl] Logging in')
      const user = Array.from(UserServiceImpl.data.values()).find(u => u.email === email)
      return user ? Effect.succeed(user) : Effect.fail(new Error('Invalid credentials'))
    })
  }
  
  // 使用组合接口
  const user = yield* UserServiceImpl.register({
    name: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com'
  })
  
  console.log('Registered user:', user)
  
  const loggedIn = yield* UserServiceImpl.login('john@example.com', 'password')
  console.log('Logged in user:', loggedIn)
  
  return user
})

Effect.runSync(program)
```

## 🎯 模块组合

### 基本模块组合

```js
import { Effect } from 'effect'

// 基本模块组合
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  // 定义模块
  const LoggerModule = {
    create: (prefix) => ({
      log: (message) => Effect.gen(function* () {
        console.log(`[${prefix}] ${message}`)
        return Effect.succeed(true)
      })
    })
  }
  
  const DatabaseModule = {
    create: (logger) => ({
      save: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
        yield* logger.log(`Saving: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`)
        yield* Effect.sleep(100)
        return Effect.succeed({ id: Date.now(), ...data })
      })
    })
  }
  
  const UserModule = {
    create: (logger, database) => ({
      create: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
        yield* logger.log('Creating user')
        const user = yield* database.save(data)
        return user
      }),
      
      get: (id) => Effect.gen(function* () {
        yield* logger.log(`Getting user: ${id}`)
        return Effect.succeed({ id, name: 'John Doe' })
      })
    })
  }
  
  // 组合模块
  const App = {
    create: () => {
      const logger = LoggerModule.create('App')
      const database = DatabaseModule.create(logger)
      const userModule = UserModule.create(logger, database)
      
      return {
        logger,
        database,
        userModule
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 使用组合模块
  const app = App.create()
  
  const user = yield* app.userModule.create({
    name: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com'
  })
  
  console.log('Created user:', user)
  
  return user
})

Effect.runSync(program)
```

### 高级模块组合

```js
import { Effect } from 'effect'

// 高级模块组合
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  // 模块工厂
  const ModuleFactory = {
    create: (name, config = {}) => {
      const module = {
        name,
        config,
        state: new Map(),
        services: {},
        dependencies: {},
        
        addService: (serviceName, service) => {
          module.services[serviceName] = service
        },
        
        addDependency: (depName, depModule) => {
          module.dependencies[depName] = depModule
        },
        
        getService: (serviceName) => {
          return module.services[serviceName]
        },
        
        getDependency: (depName) => {
          return module.dependencies[depName]
        }
      }
      
      return module
    }
  }
  
  // 创建模块
  const loggerModule = ModuleFactory.create('LoggerModule', { prefix: 'App' })
  
  loggerModule.addService('Logger', {
    log: (message) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log(`[${loggerModule.config.prefix}] ${message}`)
      return Effect.succeed(true)
    })
  })
  
  const databaseModule = ModuleFactory.create('DatabaseModule')
  databaseModule.addDependency('logger', loggerModule)
  
  databaseModule.addService('Database', {
    save: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const logger = databaseModule.getDependency('logger').getService('Logger')
      yield* logger.log(`Saving: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`)
      yield* Effect.sleep(100)
      return Effect.succeed({ id: Date.now(), ...data })
    })
  })
  
  const userModule = ModuleFactory.create('UserModule')
  userModule.addDependency('logger', loggerModule)
  userModule.addDependency('database', databaseModule)
  
  userModule.addService('UserService', {
    create: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      const logger = userModule.getDependency('logger').getService('Logger')
      const database = userModule.getDependency('database').getService('Database')
      
      yield* logger.log('Creating user')
      const user = yield* database.save(data)
      return user
    })
  })
  
  // 模块组合器
  const ModuleComposer = {
    compose: (modules) => {
      const composed = {
        modules: {},
        
        getModule: (name) => {
          return composed.modules[name]
        },
        
        getService: (moduleName, serviceName) => {
          const module = composed.getModule(moduleName)
          return module ? module.getService(serviceName) : null
        }
      }
      
      // 注册模块
      for (const module of modules) {
        composed.modules[module.name] = module
      }
      
      return composed
    }
  }
  
  // 组合模块
  const app = ModuleComposer.compose([
    loggerModule,
    databaseModule,
    userModule
  ])
  
  // 使用组合的模块
  const userService = app.getService('UserModule', 'UserService')
  const user = yield* userService.create({
    name: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com'
  })
  
  console.log('Created user:', user)
  
  return user
})

Effect.runSync(program)
```

## 📝 实际应用示例

### 综合模块系统

```js
import { Effect } from 'effect'

// 综合模块系统
const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  // 模块系统
  const ModuleSystem = {
    modules: new Map(),
    
    register: (module) => {
      ModuleSystem.modules.set(module.name, module)
    },
    
    get: (name) => {
      return ModuleSystem.modules.get(name)
    },
    
    init: () => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log('[ModuleSystem] Initializing modules')
      
      // 初始化所有模块
      for (const [name, module] of ModuleSystem.modules) {
        if (module.init) {
          yield* module.init()
        }
      }
      
      return Effect.succeed(true)
    })
  }
  
  // 创建核心模块
  const CoreModule = ModuleFactory.create('CoreModule')
  
  CoreModule.addService('EventBus', {
    events: [],
    
    publish: (event) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log(`[CoreModule] Publishing event: ${event.type}`)
      CoreModule.services.EventBus.events.push(event)
      return Effect.succeed(true)
    }),
    
    subscribe: (handler) => {
      CoreModule.services.EventBus.events.push({ type: 'SUBSCRIPTION', handler })
      return Effect.succeed(true)
    }
  })
  
  // 创建用户模块
  const UserModule = ModuleFactory.create('UserModule')
  UserModule.addDependency('core', CoreModule)
  
  UserModule.addService('UserService', {
    users: new Map(),
    
    create: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log('[UserModule] Creating user')
      
      const eventBus = UserModule.getDependency('core').getService('EventBus')
      
      const user = { id: Date.now(), ...data }
      UserModule.services.UserService.users.set(user.id, user)
      
      // 发布事件
      yield* eventBus.publish({
        type: 'USER_CREATED',
        user
      })
      
      return user
    })
  })
  
  // 创建订单模块
  const OrderModule = ModuleFactory.create('OrderModule')
  OrderModule.addDependency('core', CoreModule)
  OrderModule.addDependency('user', UserModule)
  
  OrderModule.addService('OrderService', {
    orders: new Map(),
    
    create: (data) => Effect.gen(function* () {
      console.log('[OrderModule] Creating order')
      
      const eventBus = OrderModule.getDependency('core').getService('EventBus')
      const userService = OrderModule.getDependency('user').getService('UserService')
      
      // 验证用户
      const user = userService.users.get(data.userId)
      if (!user) {
        return Effect.fail(new Error('User not found'))
      }
      
      const order = {
        id: Date.now(),
        userId: data.userId,
        items: data.items,
        total: data.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0),
        createdAt: new Date()
      }
      
      OrderModule.services.OrderService.orders.set(order.id, order)
      
      // 发布事件
      yield* eventBus.publish({
        type: 'ORDER_CREATED',
        order
      })
      
      return order
    })
  })
  
  // 注册模块
  ModuleSystem.register(CoreModule)
  ModuleSystem.register(UserModule)
  ModuleSystem.register(OrderModule)
  
  // 初始化系统
  yield* ModuleSystem.init()
  
  // 使用模块系统
  const userService = ModuleSystem.get('UserModule').getService('UserService')
  const user = yield* userService.create({
    name: 'John Doe',
    email: 'john@example.com'
  })
  
  console.log('Created user:', user)
  
  const orderService = ModuleSystem.get('OrderModule').getService('OrderService')
  const order = yield* orderService.create({
    userId: user.id,
    items: [{ name: 'Product 1', price: 100 }]
  })
  
  console.log('Created order:', order)
  
  return { user, order }
})

Effect.runSync(program)
```
